claims.claim_text: Indexed Charles H. Sawyer is confirmed as museum director and OSS Art Looting Investigation Unit member Charles Henry Sawyer.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact name, Box 680 index context and NARA biography's direct pointer to the Charles H. Sawyer OSS personnel file establish the match.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed through the exact-name NARA personnel-file biography and NAID 2185148.
claims.temporal_assessment: The biography supplies a continuous 1924-1945 education, museum, Army and OSS chronology.
claims.match_notes: The adjacent Charles W. Sawyer row remains a separate person entity and visible possible duplicate; it is not silently merged.

claims.claim_text: Charles H. Sawyer's immediate pre-OSS affiliation was the U.S. Army's Monuments, Fine Arts and Archives program.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: He entered the Army on June 21, 1943, performed MFA&A work and transferred to the OSS London office on December 13, 1944.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed through the personnel-file-based NARA biography.
claims.temporal_assessment: Explicit dated Army-to-OSS transfer chronology.
claims.match_notes: Military service is not labeled as civilian employment.

claims.claim_text: Charles H. Sawyer's last civilian employer before Army service was the Worcester Art Museum, where he was director.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The NARA biography says Worcester hired him as director in 1940 and that he took leave to begin Army service on June 21, 1943.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed through the direct personnel-file chronology.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly bounded by the 1940 hiring year and exact Army-entry date.
claims.match_notes: The museum job is separated from his later Army and OSS assignments.

claims.claim_text: Before Worcester, Charles H. Sawyer worked at Phillips Academy as the Addison Gallery's first curator and director and as an art instructor and department chair.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The NARA biography places these Phillips Academy roles after his 1930-1932 Harvard art study and before his 1940 Worcester appointment.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed through the same exact-person NARA biography.
claims.temporal_assessment: Documented prewar employment, not the immediate predecessor to OSS.
claims.match_notes: Education is not treated as employment; only the separately documented Academy appointments are modeled as jobs.

claims.claim_text: Indexed Joseph Savoldi Jr. is identified at high confidence as professional wrestler and OSS member Joseph Anthony 'Jumping Joe' Savoldi Jr.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The distinctive indexed name and suffix align with an NPS biography and an official OSS operational report that both name Joseph Savoldi Jr.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the exact distinctive name and suffix in two independent official or institutional OSS sources.
claims.temporal_assessment: The NPS chronology dates recruitment to 1942 and the FDR Library record documents the subsequent McGregor mission.
claims.match_notes: High rather than confirmed because the indexed Box 679 personnel file has not been inspected directly by the project.
